title: Keep your data private on 10 devices for 5 years with AdGuard VPN at just $34.97
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: Protect up to 10 devices for five years with an AdGuard VPN subscription for $34.97 (MSRP $359.40) through September 20.

Most VPN services bill you month after month, and five years of that runs into the hundreds. A one-time price ends the recurring charge, and a 5-year AdGuard VPN subscription is on sale for $34.97 (MSRP $359.40) from the team behind the well-known AdGuard ad blocker.

Your subscription connects up to 10 devices at once, so one account can protect your computer, phone, and tablet together. AdGuard runs its own connection protocol for faster speeds, and a no-logging policy means your browsing history stays off their servers. With more than 70 server locations available, you can route your connection through another country and reach content that region-locks you out at home. Unlimited data keeps streaming and downloads running without a cap, and the apps work across macOS, Windows, iOS, Android, and Google Chrome.

This price is open to new AdGuard users. Be sure to redeem your code within 30 days.

Cover all your devices for five years and stop paying a VPN bill every month.

Until September 20 at 11:59pm Pacific, get a 5-year AdGuard VPN subscription on sale for $34.97 (MSRP $359.40).
